MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_FORTE.title: Forte
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_FORTE.description: Improves the effects of Attack, Skill, and Power Notes.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PHRASE_START.title: Phrase Start
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PHRASE_START.description: Triggers when the Note rack is empty.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PHRASE_END.title: Phrase End
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PHRASE_END.description: Triggers when exactly one Note slot is empty.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PERFORMANCE.title: Performance
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_PERFORMANCE.description: Played at the start of the next several turns.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_STARRY.title: Starry
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_STARRY.description: Playing this card generates a Starry Note, which grants [img]res://MGRMod/images/characters/energy_text.png[/img] when triggered.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_BASIC_NOTES.title: Basic Notes
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_BASIC_NOTES.description: Attack, Skill, Power, Status, and Curse Notes correspond to the five basic card types.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_ATTACK_NOTE.title: Attack Note
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_ATTACK_NOTE.description: Deals 2 damage to a random enemy when triggered, increased by 2 per Forte.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_SKILL_NOTE.title: Skill Note
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_SKILL_NOTE.description: Grants 1 Block when triggered, increased by 1 per Forte.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_POWER_NOTE.title: Power Note
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_POWER_NOTE.description: Draw 1 card, increased by 1 per 2 Forte.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_STATUS_NOTE.title: Status Note
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_STATUS_NOTE.description: Apply 1 Weak and Vulnerable to all enemies. Unaffected by Forte.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_CURSE_NOTE.title: Curse Note
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_CURSE_NOTE.description: Heals 2 HP when triggered and is unaffected by Forte.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_STARRY_NOTE.title: Starry Note
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_GHOST_NOTE.title: Ghost Note
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_GHOST_NOTE.description: Grants 1 Intangible when triggered and is unaffected by Forte.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_CHORD.title: Chord
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_CHORD.description: When all Note slots are filled, resolves every slotted Note in order and empties the rack.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_OMNIA_NOTE.title: Omnia Note
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_OMNIA_NOTE.description: Has the effects of all 5 Basic Notes and the Starry Note.
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_EMPTY_NOTE_SLOT.title: Empty Note Slot
MGR_MOD_KEYWORD_EMPTY_NOTE_SLOT.descript: Playing a card generates the corresponding Note based on its type. When all Note slots are filled, trigger a Chord and resolve every Note.
